entries.title: RDP black screen / freezes from RdpIdd.dll crash + huge WER dumps
symptoms: Black RDP screens, reconnect loops, slow logins
Disk at 100%, 4 KB reads taking 30–70+ seconds
Winlogon Event 4008; SessionEnv Disconnect/Reconnect delays of 77–303 seconds
WUDFHost / DriverFrameworks-UserMode events 10111, 10120, 10121
entries.root_cause: Windows RDP indirect display driver (RdpIdd.dll) becomes unstable; Windows Error Reporting writes very large dumps (≈61.5–196 GB under LocalService Temp and ProgramData\Microsoft\WDF), saturating the system disk and starving all sessions.
solution: Identify and delete/limit WER dump files after an incident
Log off stuck sessions after disk recovers
Limit WER dumps for WUDFHost (LocalDumps DumpType=1 or disable WDF heap dumps) so a driver crash cannot fill the disk again

On Server 2019/2022: GPO «Use WDDM graphics display driver for Remote Desktop Connections» = Disabled (legacy XDDM). On Server 2025 this policy often has no effect — RdpIdd may still load; install latest cumulative updates instead
Investigate interaction with call-recording software (see recording-* entries)
prevention: Cap or disable large WER/WDF dumps on session hosts
Keep Server 2025 RDP stack patched
Separate OS/user disk from dump/recording I/O where possible
Monitor disk latency and WUDFHost/RdpIdd events

entries.title: Old recorder kept polling invalidated Remote Audio after RDP disconnect
symptoms: Long SessionEnv disconnect (≈300 s) then reconnect
Possible abandoned RdpIdd swapchain / black screen after reconnect
Huge per-user recorder.log (hundreds of thousands of lines)
entries.root_cause: After RDP disconnect, recorder left in the disconnected session kept WASAPI loopback + session manager open on an invalidated Remote Audio endpoint and polled it ~2×/sec; calls hung 60–256 s in the same windows as SessionEnv 300 s delays.
solution: Upgrade recorder to ≥0.2.0 / 0.2.1 / 0.2.2: on disconnect release audio devices and signal port immediately; reopen lost devices with backoff; cap logs
Remove old per-user installs under Documents\Recorder-package\ and Telegram Downloads
Install once under C:\Program Files\Recorder\ and point HKCU Run «Recorder» there
Verify disconnect/reconnect lines in %APPDATA%\Recorder\recorder.log
prevention: Single shared install path; inventory with Get-Process / Get-ChildItem before rollout
Do not trust FileVersion «1.0.0.0» from old builds — use size (~72 MB single exe) and pNNN log tags
A/B: disable recorder for 1–2 days when RDP instability returns

entries.title: Recorder could not run for multiple users on one RDP host
symptoms: Starting recorder under user A blocks launch under user B on the same server
entries.root_cause: Application treated as single-instance across sessions on a multi-user RDS host.
solution: Ask vendor for multi-instance / multi-session support; deploy fixed build that allows concurrent per-session instances
prevention: Validate multi-session install before production rollout on RDS

entries.title: Every incoming call froze the session for a few seconds
symptoms: System freezes briefly on every incoming call
entries.root_cause: suspected: older recorder build interaction with call audio path
solution: Install latest recorder + Lite version — freezes disappeared immediately
prevention: Keep recorder on current release; regression-test on incoming calls after upgrades

entries.title: AUDCLNT_E_DEVICE_INVALIDATED (0x88890004) on Remote Audio
symptoms: Recorder logs device loss; MicroSIP loses mic/speaker at the same moment
entries.root_cause: Windows invalidates the session audio endpoint (disconnect/reconnect, Audiosrv restart, or WUDFHost/RdpIdd crash). Recorder is a witness, not the cause.
solution: Recorder retries with backoff (5 s … 60 s)
Collect correlating events: TerminalServices 24/25/40, Audiosrv, WUDFHost 10111, scheduled tasks around the timestamp
prevention: Stabilize RDP display/audio stack; avoid scheduled maintenance that restarts audio mid-shift

entries.title: NFS export shows folders but access returns ENOENT (d?????????)
symptoms: Directory listing shows many folders; ls -la shows d?????????
Access returns «No such file or directory»
Recurred after a previous Nov 4 fix; by Nov 10 only ~21/76 folders readable
entries.root_cause: NFS export on 85.206.172.48 losing/corrupting exported directory entries (exact server-side cause not fully documented in chat).
solution: Re-apply the same server-side fix used on Nov 4
Longer-term: prefer SMB share for recorder folders if NFS keeps failing
prevention: Monitor NFS export health; consider SMB for multi-writer recorder storage

entries.title: Recording writes competing with OS/RDP on the system disk
symptoms: Disk saturation affects RDP users when recordings write heavily
entries.root_cause: Recordings and user/OS I/O share the same disk.
solution: Add a dedicated disk (or volume) for recordings so 100% util on that disk does not starve RDP
prevention: Keep media/recording I/O off the OS volume

entries.title: WhatsApp WinUI/memory crash + failed package re-register on multi-user host
symptoms: WhatsApp crashes; Windows repair of the package fails while other users still run it
entries.root_cause: WhatsApp memory/WinUI crash; concurrent multi-user package state blocks clean re-register.
solution: Close WhatsApp for ALL users
Repair/re-register the AppX package cleanly
Then reopen; if needed update/replace WhatsApp version
prevention: Coordinate WhatsApp updates off-hours; avoid partial per-user repairs on RDS

entries.title: WhatsApp dial/call UI freeze (WebView2); process still «responding»
symptoms: Outgoing call freezes UI; WhatsApp.Root.exe still shows responding; mass reports
entries.root_cause: WhatsApp via Edge WebView2; frozen WebView process; outdated WebView2 Runtime.
solution: Restart WhatsApp WebView process to restore calls immediately
Update WebView2 Runtime (e.g. 154.0.4258.62 → 155.0.4283.45)
Do not close WhatsApp during freeze if capturing logs for RCA
prevention: Keep WebView2 Runtime current on session hosts; monitor after updates

entries.title: WhatsApp freezes ~30–35 s during calls due to WMI process scan on UI thread
symptoms: UI freezes during calls while audio continues; worse on heavily loaded hosts
entries.root_cause: WhatsApp runs a WMI process scan on the main UI thread; with >5000 processes on the RDP server the scan takes ~30–35 s.
solution: Split users across additional RDP servers to reduce process count per host
prevention: Capacity-plan RDS hosts; avoid packing too many concurrent sessions/apps on one box

entries.title: WhatsApp voice call fails (no camera; mic permission suspected)
symptoms: Cannot start regular call before switching to video; no camera on server
entries.root_cause: suspected: WhatsApp missing microphone permission in the RDP session
solution: Grant mic permission; verify via AnyDesk on the affected session; start audio call then switch to video if needed
prevention: Pre-configure WhatsApp/Chrome mic permissions in default user profile / Chrome policy

entries.title: General RDP lag / noisy neighbor on multi-session hosts
symptoms: Slow sessions, contention between users, leftover profiles wasting disk
entries.root_cause: Balanced power plan, Fair Share disabled for disk/network, unlimited idle/disconnected sessions, heavy Chrome/WhatsApp profiles, OS temp clutter.
solution: Power plan → High performance
Re-enable disk/network Fair Share (CPU Fair Share already on)
Session limits: idle 60 min disconnect; disconnected 60 min logoff
Display max 1920×1080, no wallpaper; per-session Temp deleted at logoff
QoS DSCP 46 on UDP for VoIP; fixed 32 GB pagefile on C:
Chrome: Memory Saver, 256 MB cache, no HW accel, no background mode; allow web.whatsapp.com mic/notifications
Default profile: best performance visual effects; disable tips/background apps; strip OneDrive first-run
Logon script Optimize-CurrentUser.ps1; disable machine-wide non-Microsoft startups
Delete unused Retention profiles; free disk
prevention: Apply via GPO; keep logon optimization; review Fair Share after major changes

entries.title: RDP freezes possibly worsened by single NIC RSS queue
symptoms: Intermittent RDP freezes under network load
entries.root_cause: Server NIC using only 1 RSS receive queue, concentrating network processing on few cores.
solution: Increase RSS receive queues to 8; monitor whether freezes continue
prevention: Validate NIC RSS/RSS queues on new session hosts

entries.title: Daytime Windows Update causes mass RDP disconnect/freeze
symptoms: Many users disconnect/reconnect at once; sessions freeze
entries.root_cause: Windows Update consuming bandwidth/resources during business hours (correlated in RDP logs).
solution: Reschedule Windows Updates to night / maintenance window
prevention: WSUS/maintenance window policy; never allow interactive daytime CU installs on prod RDS

entries.title: Very slow upload over WireGuard VPN (~6 Mbps)
symptoms: Upload ≈6 Mbps over VPN despite better underlying capacity
entries.root_cause: TCP packet sizing / MSS issues over WireGuard causing severe sensitivity to packet loss.
solution: Optimize TCP MSS settings — upload improved ≈6 → 47 Mbps
prevention: Tune MSS/MTU when deploying WireGuard for RDP/file transfer paths

entries.title: Admin VPN would hijack default gateway and break other RDP users
symptoms: Need VPN path to a remote RDP server without changing server public routing
entries.root_cause: Full-tunnel OpenVPN changes default gateway on the Windows server.
solution: Use stock RDP client + OpenVPN split tunnel
Modify .ovpn: do not replace default gateway; add specific route to destination IP only
prevention: Never full-tunnel VPN on multi-user session hosts

entries.title: RDP exposed on public internet
symptoms: RDP reachable from the public network
entries.root_cause: Direct public exposure of RDP endpoints.
solution: Move access to NetBird (WireGuard-based) private network with strict access policies
prevention: Keep RDP off public IPs; access only via mesh VPN

entries.title: Agent connectivity issues blamed on VPN but caused by bad cable
symptoms: Slow/unstable agent connection; switching VPN did not help
entries.root_cause: Faulty physical network cable at the agent workstation.
solution: Replace cable; verify with continuous ping before blaming VPN/RDP
prevention: Isolate: office-wide vs single user; ping during incident; check layer-1 first

entries.title: Wi-Fi drops from UniFi U6-Pro Ethernet/PoE link flaps
symptoms: Wi-Fi disconnections; APs briefly offline
entries.root_cause: Physical Ethernet link interruptions on MikroTik ports to U6-Pro APs (ports 9/10). Exact cause open (cables replaced; investigate PoE/injectors/shared infra). Firmware 6.8.2; no CRC errors.
solution: Investigate PoE power, injectors, connectors, shared infrastructure
Monitor link flaps in switch logs
prevention: Stable PoE budget and cabling; alert on link flaps

entries.title: Intermittent robotic/choppy call audio (RDP stable)
symptoms: Agent heard intermittently/robotically on CRM click-to-call; multiple lines; RDP connection stable
entries.root_cause: unknown/suspected: path between agent PC ↔ RDP ↔ PBX/provider (need isolation). Not always RDP.
solution: Enable mic monitoring in headphones: if own voice is already choppy inside RDP, fault is before MicroSIP/PBX
Compare desks/servers; test provider vs local network
QoS DSCP 46 for VoIP UDP on session hosts
prevention: Document isolation playbook: local loopback monitor → MicroSIP → trunk → provider

entries.title: Temporary MicroSIP registration failures from one public IP
symptoms: Multiple extensions unavailable at once
entries.root_cause: Several MicroSIP registrations from the same public IP stopped renewing briefly; Asterisk marked them unavailable. Not deleted extensions or permanent firewall block.
solution: Wait/restore registrations; they come back when renewals resume; confirm not a permanent IP ban
prevention: Monitor SIP registration renewals; alert on mass unavailability per IP

entries.title: Wrong SIP password → IP blocked
symptoms: Extension cannot register; IP appears blocked
entries.root_cause: Extension repeatedly authenticates with incorrect password; fail2ban/firewall blocks the IP.
solution: Fix password; unblock IP; verify registration
prevention: Distribute credentials carefully; alert on auth failures before ban threshold

entries.title: Dashboard shows ANSWERED / wrong billing from internal Asterisk CDR rows
symptoms: Calls marked answered incorrectly; confusing uncharged call stats
entries.root_cause: Asterisk creates multiple CDR rows per call; dashboard sometimes read an internal row as ANSWERED instead of provider/trunk result.
solution: Treat provider trunk CDR as source of truth; uncharged OK for internal/BUSY/NO ANSWER
prevention: Always filter CDR by trunk/provider leg for billing dashboards

entries.title: CRM call duration longer than recording (carrier marks answered on ring)
symptoms: e.g. duration 44 s vs recording 20 s
entries.root_cause: Some carriers mark call answered when ringing starts; CRM took carrier duration including ring time; recording is talk-only.
solution: Prefer conversation-time duration in CRM; clarify with carrier; recording is authoritative for talk time
prevention: Document carrier answer semantics; use recording or bridged talk timer for duration

entries.title: CRM HTTP 500 when phone extension incompatible
symptoms: 500 errors around click-to-call / phone features
entries.root_cause: Extension not compatible with CRM phone integration.
solution: Align extension config with CRM expectations; fix mapping
prevention: Validate extension provisioning against CRM schema before assigning to agents

entries.title: Lead CSV import fails on duplicate emails / opaque errors
symptoms: Import errors; deleting rows yields new errors; desire to edit in-place without Excel round-trip
entries.root_cause: Uploaded file contains duplicate email addresses; error messaging insufficiently actionable for operators.
solution: Deduplicate emails in source file; explain error = duplicate in upload; improve UX to edit/map without full re-upload where possible
prevention: Pre-validate CSV for unique email/phone; clearer row-level error messages

entries.title: Unclear duplicate lead rejection rules across days / FTD
symptoms: Confusion when same phone/email can or cannot re-register
entries.root_cause: Product rules needed clarification.
solution: Same phone/email same day → reject as duplicate
Next day → allowed as new client
If deposit ≥ $250 (FTD threshold) → treat as duplicate for 30 days
Registration Links page for WT/Owner/duplicate policy
prevention: Document policy in CRM UI; registration-link level controls

entries.title: Concurrent affiliate lead POSTs reject one of the leads
symptoms: Occasional lead rejected when affiliates send at the exact same moment
entries.root_cause: Race/conflict under simultaneous affiliate API submissions.
solution: Implement server-side fix for concurrent lead creation conflict
prevention: Idempotency keys / transactional locking on lead create path

entries.title: Need percentage split of affiliate leads across multiple agents
symptoms: Single fixed owner insufficient for 70/30 (etc.) desk splits
entries.root_cause: Product gap (not a bug).
solution: Lead Distribution in Affiliate User settings: agents + percentages = 100%
Sequential (not random) assignment; deactivate agent redistributes share
Priority: API Owner > duplicate→original owner > distribution > default owner
History/audit of changes
prevention: N/A — feature

entries.title: Request for multiple owners conflicts with multi-brand CRM ownership model
symptoms: Business wants shared ownership; system has single owner semantics for deposits/chat/support
entries.root_cause: Ownership is deep in multi-CRM/multi-brand design.
solution: Prefer «Viewers» field for extra access without changing owner/credit logic
prevention: Clarify access vs ownership in requirements before changing core assignment

entries.title: Calendar times wrong for all users
symptoms: Displayed calendar times offset from real
entries.root_cause: Incorrect time configuration.
solution: Correct time settings going forward; bulk-shift existing calendar entries retroactively
prevention: Validate timezone on brand/CRM setup checklist

entries.title: Confusion between Total FTD, day conversion, and QFTD ($250+)
symptoms: Numbers disagree across cards/screenshots
entries.root_cause: Different definitions: day-to-day conversion vs all FTDs in period vs qualified FTD ≥ $250 single deposit.
solution: Ship Total FTD Conversion + Valid Leads / Valid Conversion cards
Document: Total FTD = any amount; QFTD = ≥$250; Valid statuses configurable in Module Fields
prevention: Keep metric definitions visible in UI tooltips

entries.title: UI translated but month names not localized
symptoms: Months remain in wrong language
entries.root_cause: Incomplete localization of date formatting.
solution: Fix month name localization
prevention: Include date/month tokens in translation QA

entries.title: Weak passwords accepted for clients/staff
symptoms: Need enforceable password rules
entries.root_cause: Insufficient policy.
solution: Min 8 (10 for CRM employees/affiliates), max 128
Blacklist ~50 common passwords; reject numbers-only and repeated single char
Cannot match email/local-part; no forced complexity mix
prevention: Keep blacklist updated

entries.title: Affiliate display name change not visible until service restart
symptoms: Renamed affiliate still shows old name externally
entries.root_cause: Affiliate service caches names until restart.
solution: Restart affiliate service after name changes
prevention: Hot-reload or cache bust on rename

entries.title: Telephony issue cleared when main PBX disconnected — clients still on main
symptoms: Problems persist until main server disconnected; backup not actually primary
entries.root_cause: Endpoints still registered/routed to main PBX; backup not configured as primary.
solution: Properly promote backup as main if that is intended; verify where clients are connected
prevention: Failover drills; confirm active registration target after cutover

entries.title: Wallet balance source unclear (API vs webhook)
symptoms: Uncertainty how Balance should be maintained when webhook exists
entries.root_cause: Integration design ambiguity (List/Generate/save wallet clear; Balance path unclear).
solution: If webhook delivers balance updates, do not also poll balance API — align on single source of truth
prevention: Document wallet integration contract before build

entries.title: Office IP banned by PBX after SIP auth failure loop
symptoms: Whole office loses SIP/RDP-related access; mass extension failures
entries.root_cause: One extension repeatedly fails authentication; PBX fail2ban bans the entire office public IP.
solution: Unban IP on PBX
Fix the misconfigured extension password
Verify registrations resume
prevention: Alert on per-extension auth failures before ban threshold; avoid sharing one egress IP without monitoring

entries.title: Same SIP extension assigned to multiple CRM users → 500 / freezes
symptoms: MicroSIP 500 errors; call freezes; incompatible extension messages
entries.root_cause: Duplicate or incompatible SIP extension mapping in CRM (same extension on multiple users).
solution: Enumerate and unique-map extensions to users; align CRM extension config
prevention: Provisioning check: one extension ↔ one CRM user

entries.title: Incoming-call freezes from MicroSIP «Bring to Front» / outdated build
symptoms: Session freezes on every incoming call
entries.root_cause: MicroSIP setting «Bring to Front on Incoming Call» plus outdated MicroSIP builds interacting badly on RDS.
solution: Disable Bring to Front; install latest MicroSIP (+ Lite where applicable) — freezes stopped
prevention: Standardize MicroSIP settings via baseline image; block old builds

entries.title: PBX ~94% CPU / freezes after too many extensions
symptoms: PBX freezes; call quality issues independent of RDP overcrowding
entries.root_cause: PBX overloaded after scaling extensions beyond original design capacity.
solution: Treat PBX capacity as separate workstream from RDP; reorganize/split before further growth
prevention: Capacity plan PBX separately; monitor CPU/extension counts

entries.title: Client cannot hear agent for first ~10 seconds
symptoms: One-way audio at call start (~10 s), then normal
entries.root_cause: unknown/suspected: early media / RDP audio device readiness / media path setup delay
solution: Continue isolation with mic-monitor and provider early-media checks; correlate with audio device invalidation events
prevention: Ensure audio endpoint ready before dial; review early-media/ringback settings

entries.title: Robotic/intermittent audio on distant Singapore RDP server
symptoms: Robotic/choppy audio for users on Singapore RDP; some still dual-logged on old+new servers
entries.root_cause: suspected: high latency Singapore RDP ↔ PBX path; VPN routing; dual sessions
solution: Move users to nearer hosts; ensure single active session; validate VPN path to PBX
prevention: Keep voice-critical agents on low-latency RDP↔PBX geography

entries.title: Recordings written to C:\Documents instead of D: per-user path
symptoms: Recordings land on system disk / wrong folder
entries.root_cause: Per-user recorder installs misconfigured; output left at Documents\Recorder instead of D:\username.
solution: Reconfigure output path; prefer shared Program Files install with correct storage target
prevention: Baseline config.json in deployment; verify path on first login

entries.title: New security monitoring tool auto-blocks all RDP access
symptoms: All RDP access blocked after installing security monitoring
entries.root_cause: Tool activated blocking mode automatically on install.
solution: Disable blocking mode / uninstall or whitelist; restore RDP access
prevention: Deploy security tools in monitor-only first; never enable auto-block on prod RDS without pilot

entries.title: CRM login rate limits lock whole desk IPs
symptoms: Entire desk cannot log in after several failed attempts
entries.root_cause: Security hardening: e.g. 5 fails/15m per user+IP and 10 fails/15m per shared IP; agents retry weak/wrong passwords from one office egress.
solution: Unblock IP/users; communicate new limits; stagger retries; fix passwords
prevention: Tune shared-IP thresholds for office NAT; UI guidance on password policy

entries.title: Stricter password policy rejects resets without clear UI errors
symptoms: Password reset fails with opaque error
entries.root_cause: New rules deployed without tooltip/error explaining which rule failed.
solution: Document rules (length, blacklist, no numbers-only, no repeated chars, not email local-part); add UI guidance
prevention: Ship policy text with the enforcement

entries.title: RDP/SIP access lost when office IP drops from whitelist
symptoms: Sudden loss of RDP/SIP after IP change or inactivity
entries.root_cause: Auto-expiry of unused whitelist IPs and/or VPN egress IP change; NetBird migration incomplete for some hosts.
solution: Re-add current egress IP; complete NetBird cutover so public whitelist is less critical
prevention: Prefer mesh VPN over mutable IP allowlists; alert on whitelist expiry

entries.title: Agent cannot connect to RDP due to personal VPN exit country
symptoms: Single user cannot reach RDP while others can
entries.root_cause: User VPN egress set to unexpected country (e.g. Netherlands) not matching allowlist/path.
solution: Disable personal VPN or switch exit; connect via approved path
prevention: Document allowed connectivity; prefer NetBird client

entries.title: Random user black screen suspected from stuck logon script
symptoms: Daily random users get black screen at login
entries.root_cause: unknown/suspected: Optimize-CurrentUser.ps1 / logon script hangs and blocks desktop load
solution: Check %TEMP%\RDSOptimize.log; run script async if needed; isolate affected profiles
prevention: Timeout logon scripts; make optimizations non-blocking

entries.title: Reports show more FTDs than Clients list for a desk
symptoms: FTD counts in Reports disagree with filtered Clients list
entries.root_cause: Reports credit FTD to desk/agent at deposit time; Clients filters by current owner/desk after moves.
solution: Explain timing vs current-owner semantics; use Reports for historical credit
prevention: UI note on credit-at-event vs current-owner filters

entries.title: WebTrader/CRM P&L mismatch on long-lived sessions
symptoms: P&L differs between WebTrader and CRM after long open session
entries.root_cause: Client left WebTrader open too long; stale UI state (auto-refresh insufficient after >1 hour).
solution: Refresh/reload WebTrader; educate users not to leave sessions open indefinitely
prevention: Stronger auto-refresh or session staleness warning

entries.title: Need write-only storage account for recording uploads
symptoms: Uploaders must push recordings without reading others' files
entries.root_cause: Security design requirement for shared recording storage.
solution: Create restricted user with write/upload-only rights (no list/read of others)
prevention: Keep principle of least privilege on recording shares

entries.title: TP/SL set as dollar amounts instead of prices
symptoms: Users enter profit dollars into TP/SL fields incorrectly
entries.root_cause: UX misunderstanding: TP/SL are market prices, not profit dollar amounts.
solution: Clarify in UI/help that values are prices
prevention: Inline field hints / validation
